producer_report.summary: I made no new code changes. The candidate already moved the Transport items into gh/transport.rs, re-exported them from gh/mod.rs, and added a CHANGELOG entry. It passed fmt, clippy and the tests in the earlier job. The one finding was that the report must list the caller-check Grep with counts. I ran it on the current tree. `gh::<moved name>` over crates/ gives 14 hits in 9 files, all outside gh/. A Grep for `gh::transport::` gives 0 hits. The count is the same at base because no caller file changed (git status shows only CHANGELOG.md, gh/mod.rs and gh/transport.rs). I did not rerun fmt, clippy or the tests in this retry.
